name: SnowSport LT Snow Plow 80664
description: Style: w/o Front Receiver Hitch Mount. Size: 6'10" Blade. The SnowSport LT utility snow plow offers home owners an easy snow removal solution. It works on virtually any Jeep, SUV, or pickup truck. Snow plowing has never been easier, say good bye to your snow blower or plow contractor. These Snowsport LT home plows always come in handy and are the ideal plow for your driveway. The LT plow kit comes complete with an aluminum blade, push frame, and a 2" front receiver mount. This snowplow is very easy to operate and install. The plow has a turf friendly heavy-duty rubber cutting edge. It works great on cement, black top, gravel and won't damage grass surfaces. SnowSport LT snowplows have a clean, simple design that makes snow plowing easy and affordable. A heavy duty steel push frame allows the blade to use gravity to follow the contours of your driveway. The forward motion of your vehicle locks the plow into action and creates a squeegee effect that no other plow can replicate. The lightweight anodized aluminum blade will not rust or corrode and since there is no wiring or lever controls, there is nothing to clutter the interior of your cab. Plus it is simple to transfer from vehicle to vehicle. Turn your winter snow clearing chores into a fun time and get yourself a SnowSport LT snow plow!
